summary: A modular synthesizer with over 80 modules patched with virtual cables on the FM-1's screen. A browser emulator with a visual patch bay runs the same firmware and can sync with the unit over USB.
features: Oscillators, CZ and TX81Z-style FM voices, six filter types, drums
Sampler and granular player; four sample banks, recordable on the unit
Step, Euclid, Turing and piano-roll sequencer modules
16 snapshots per patch, PERFORM page, mutes, MUTATE and SONG mode
MIDI over USB and TRS; USB audio in both directions
Supports newer FM-1s with the UC25HQ80 flash chip
